A hand works a cigarette in near darkness, cut against the red car's wheel still blurring past the warehouses in daylight; the montage tips from practice into night.

chars: the greying naval officer
windows.action: Night on a quiet street by a vending machine, then a greying naval officer lets himself into a dark flat, reaches for the light switch and stands in the small kitchen, scanning rooms that stay empty.

chars: the greying naval officer
windows.action: He parts the hanging coats to look through, the camera swings onto a flat untouched bed, and in close-up his face hardens from searching to certainty: the boy is not home.
A red-lit parlour: players crowd a mahjong table while the TV behind them replays street-race footage. By the second shot a woman in a dark jacket has stood up and is walking out past the screen.

chars: the woman in the satin dress
the long-haired mentor
windows.action: One held take on the garage walkway: the woman in the satin dress comes to the rail beside the long-haired man and tells him 'You have a visitor', nodding down at the man waiting alone by a car below.
Back on the mountain road an orange RX-7 drops in alongside the red Evo; they run door to door through the trees until the frame tightens to their bumpers nearly touching in shadow.

Daylight mountain road: an orange sports car slides a guardrail bend with a red rally sedan on its tail. By the last shots the red car has drawn alongside and the driver sits back smirking, hands loose on the wheel.

Cut to night: an empty elevated expressway, then the young foreign driver inside the orange car leaning into the wheel as the red sedan sweeps past the lit suspension bridge. His focus hardens shot to shot.

Headlights roll into an empty concrete parking deck. The red sedan starts throwing drifts between the pillars, and the cuts alternate between the young Asian driver and the foreign driver, both now working hard at the wheel.
The garage deck opens out with parked cars and onlookers; the red sedan chases a white coupe across it, then drops down a lamp-lined spiral ramp and comes out drifting on a neon-lit street.
A young woman with long dark hair watches from a cheering crowd. The shot widens to a neon-sign plaza ringed with spectators, and the red sedan slides past them trailing tyre smoke.

A gold coupe eases down the same spiral ramp; the Asian driver grits his teeth mid-slide, an overhead shot shows the red sedan spinning smoke inches from bystanders, and the light-haired driver whoops in the gold car.
A held take tracks the dark-haired young woman and the Asian driver walking the packed neon street past a van with its hatch open and speakers stacked inside; they stop and turn to look off-screen.

From above the crowd closes in around the smoking car; the foreign driver, in a green bomber jacket, grins as hands reach for him, and the young woman watches from the edge of the crowd with a small smile.
Hard cut to daylight and a classroom: a teacher in a red top stands at a chalkboard covered in Japanese writing, reading aloud from a book as she moves along it.

In a daylit classroom the dark-haired girl in the school uniform works at a laptop showing a Japanese text document; a chat window cuts in over it reading 'bama_boy: how come i never c u drift???' and she reads it.

Hands type on the laptop keyboard and she breaks into a private smile; a finger hits Enter and the cut lands on the American boy at his own laptop by a window, reading the same chat line and chewing his knuckle.

Night: a wide of a parking lot under a stacked highway overpass, then inserts of vending machines selling canned coffee, a lobster dinner and hot food, before the camera finds the two of them eating together at a table.

At the table he grins and jokes with her over the cans between them; by the long second shot they are both leaning into the noodle box with chopsticks and she is laughing, the mood loosening into something easy.

His grin fades as he turns to her with a question; he lifts one of the tall cans and holds it up to make a point, then the camera pushes in close and he is simply watching her face, waiting for an answer.

Held close on her, she drops her eyes and smiles faintly as she talks; the reverse shows him staring hard, no longer smiling, and when it returns to her the smile has thinned into something more guarded.

Tight shot/reverse across the table: he presses her with a serious look, she meets his eyes instead of looking away, and his face softens as he answers, leaving her watching him steadily by the last shot.

windows.action: In a brightly lit shop the young man leans in close, talking fast and earnest; the reverse cuts to the dark-haired young woman holding his gaze without answering, her face set and wary.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
the dark-haired young woman
windows.action: Cut to night: two cars sweep through a hairpin on a mountain road, and inside one of them she is at the wheel with him beside her. They blur past the lit city below and drop back into the trees.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
the dark-haired young woman
windows.action: Inside the car the framing tightens, from a windshield two-shot to both in profile with the road streaming past. Her hand closes on the gearshift and the cut goes back out to the two cars running the road.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
the dark-haired young woman
windows.action: She glances across at him with a small smile; he keeps his eyes forward. The camera then leaves the cabin for a silver car's tail-lights on wet tarmac and an aerial of three cars strung down the mountain.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
the dark-haired young woman
windows.action: Back through the windshield his half-smile breaks into open laughter; she laughs back with one hand loose on the wheel, and the guarded mood they carried out of the shop is gone.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
the dark-haired young woman
windows.action: The laughing settles into easy back-and-forth, cutting between her smiling at the road and him grinning across at her, until he says something that she answers properly rather than joking.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
the dark-haired young woman
windows.action: His grin fades and he looks away; a two-shot finds them side by side, her still smiling at the road, before he turns and just watches her, saying nothing.

Night interior: a young man at the wheel glances at the woman beside him as they talk, the cabin lit only by dash glow. The shot opens out to the empty mountain road far below, the car gone from view.

Daylight at the dockside yard: a red sedan slides through its own tyre smoke, seen from overhead, then at the rear bumper and down at the burning wheel. The driver leans out of the window as he swings past the parked crew.

The crew lounges on salvaged couches between the cars, one reading a magazine, another playing a handheld. The red car stops and its driver, in a grey shirt, climbs out and walks over, pulling their attention up.

The camera whips round to the grey-shirt driver facing the young man in the yellow jacket under a blue tarp; they trade words. A wide pulls back across the yard, other cars still drifting in the distance.
The long-haired man in the dark coat sits slouched in a chair, hand at his mouth, then his head snaps toward something off-screen as the camera swings away with him.

A heavyset man in a tank top strides in across the lot with the long-haired man and the others falling in behind. Without warning he swings down hard, and the grey-shirt driver ends up face-down on the concrete.
The crew stands watching while the tank-top man crouches over the beaten driver and talks down at him. The driver, brow and mouth split open, lifts his head and glares back instead of staying down.
windows.censor_note: blood from a cut brow and lip on the downed man's face, a small part of the frame in the close-ups

windows.action: The tank-top man turns and walks off; the yellow-jacket youth and the long-haired man watch each other in silence. A young woman drops to her knees beside the bleeding driver as the crew leaves the lot.
windows.censor_note: blood on the downed man's face, small portion of frame

windows.action: In the dockside lot the beaten American lies on the asphalt, blood at his mouth, while the schoolgirl kneels and steadies his shoulder. The man in the hooded jacket speaks and the kid in the orange varsity jacket drops his eyes.
windows.censor_note: smeared blood on the beaten man's mouth and brow in three close shots, roughly the upper third of frame

windows.action: Morning at the school gates: bike racks and crowds of uniformed students. The schoolgirl talks with two friends while the bruised American shoulders through the crowd behind them, and her attention slides off her friend.

Still in uniform, she pushes through a cluttered back room and stops in the doorway of a dim club lounge, facing the man in the black henley, who lounges in a leather armchair with a boot on the table between two hostesses.

She holds the doorway while the blond man in the leather jacket grins and the man in the armchair keeps his eyes down, smirking. She speaks, he looks up to answer, then pushes up out of the chair toward her.

One unbroken take: he comes out from behind the leather chair and crosses the lounge to her, the camera holding as he closes the distance until the two of them stand face to face in the low orange light.

Tight singles trade back and forth: he stands over her talking quietly and raises a hand toward her face. She does not step back, and by the last shot his fingers are at her cheek and she is still holding his stare.

In a blue-lit room the young man with the shaved-side haircut backs the girl in the school uniform against a perforated wall. She answers him at first, but by the third shot she is cornered and talking fast.
He closes the last of the gap until their faces almost touch. She stops answering, turns her head aside and drops her eyes, and the camera pushes into extreme close-up on the two of them.
Held in extreme close-up, he keeps talking low into her face. Her expression breaks: a tear runs down her cheek, and she ends the exchange with her lips parted, saying nothing.
Cut to the garage: three of the crew work under a car on the lift. Outside, the girl, now in a fur-collared coat, walks in off the dark street toward the open bay.
The American under the car spots her and stares; the woman beside him turns to look, and the man at the office desk straightens up. He steps out from under the lift and walks toward her.
Face to face at the garage mouth, she keeps her eyes down with a tear on her cheek while he searches her face. The moment ends on a blurred whip-pan off her hair.
A man in a beige coat walks the aisle of a crowded pachinko parlour, then the camera whips away through the bright arcade front into the street.
A black Mercedes sits on a neon-lit alley. Its doors swing open and two men in dark suits climb out: a heavy-set bald older man, then a long-haired man who leans out over the door frame.

Night street outside a lit shopfront: a suited man hauls himself out of a parked car, a young man in a leather jacket turns toward it, a low angle catches the wheel, then the frame drops into a dark doorway inside.

Inside the smoky den players hunch over a green gambling table; the camera pushes past dark bodies into a cluttered back room where a bald man in a suit now stands holding a black folder, crew gathered round him.

chars: Kamata
windows.action: An older man in a white suit and panama hat appears in the yellow corridor; the young man in the black shirt looks up, and by the last shot Kamata has stepped into the back room greeted as the uncle he was about to visit.

chars: Kamata
windows.action: Kamata asks if he has been well and the younger man grins yes; the talk turns to business as he leans over the desk and hands across last week's take, Kamata standing over him while the crew hangs back.

chars: Kamata
windows.action: The younger man straightens, then puts an open palm out toward the leather armchair; by the wide shot Kamata has turned his back on him and is walking to the seat he has been offered.

chars: Kamata
windows.action: Kamata settles into the armchair and fixes him with a stare; the younger man drops his eyes, and the wide finds the old man at the desk with a ledger open, working through the books while the other stands waiting.

chars: Kamata
windows.action: Going through the printouts, Kamata admits he doesn't understand half of what he is looking at; the younger man laughs it off as more complicated than it is, and the smile dies as the old man just sits silent.

In a blue-lit office a young man in a black henley stands before an elderly man in a white suit and panama hat sunk in a leather armchair; the accusation that his partner is stealing lands and he drops his eyes.
The seated man in white keeps talking over the younger man's shoulder, eyes lowered, then lifts them to him; the reverse finds the young man standing stiff and silent, offering nothing back.
The old man works through a proverb, 'For want of a steed... the war was lost,' the camera pushing tighter on him each cut; the younger man first looks away, then lowers his head as the point lands.

The old man's face sinks into shadow under his hat brim as he looks down; a white-sleeved hand lifts a small framed picture from the cluttered desk, and he stands holding it, still not raising his eyes.

Wide: the old man comes round the desk and holds the framed picture out to the young man. The next shot finds the younger man doubled over, head hanging, before focus slides off onto the blurred desktop.
Close on a table: a man in a cream sweater lifts and turns a patterned cup while a second pair of hands opposite cradles a small cup; he sets the cup down and settles back, the talk unhurried.

the man in the black shirt
windows.action: The garage crowd stands behind the chain under a car on the lift; outside in the night lot a blond man in a leather jacket swings out of a gold coupe and a man in black strides in between parked cars.

windows.action: At the mezzanine rail the man in the cream sweater and the dark-haired young woman talk; her attention drifts off him, and by the last shot she has twisted around, staring hard toward the floor below.

windows.action: The long-haired mechanic looks up from under the lift as the man in the black shirt storms in, gets in his face shouting, then grabs him by the collar and shoves him back against the tyre racks.

windows.action: Held by the collar, the mechanic answers back evenly while the man in black keeps shouting; the shot widens to the onlookers - the young woman, the man in the cream sweater and the blond in leather.

the man in the cream sweater

windows.action: The man in black pulls a pistol and levels it at the mechanic's face; the mechanic holds still and keeps talking. Upstairs the teen in the green shirt jerks off the couch and the crowd freezes.
A smeared whip-pan goes dark and settles into a long held wide of the dim garage bay - yellow coupe, hanging chains, the roller shutter down - with the confrontation now out of frame.

chars: the blond man in the leather jacket
the man in the cream sweater
windows.action: In near-darkness the group breaks for the doors: the blond man turns in a doorway, the man in the cream sweater drops into a driver's seat and locks both hands on the wheel, then a blurred rush past brick.

A dark side street at night; a black sports car sits idling with its headlights lit, then the view moves inside a car parked in the tuning garage, where the driver watches the lit workshop through the glass.

The garage erupts: a mechanic dives flat as the red Evo is boarded and a blond figure in a leather jacket swings past, then the car bursts out of the bay in a shower of sparks and slews away down the lot.

Close on the driver in the white sweater at the wheel; behind him the crew scatters, one ducking under the rolling shutter and another vaulting at a silver coupe, and the black and yellow cars pull out after him.

Inside the red car the driver glances back with a passenger beside him, the road ahead is empty, a long-haired driver grips his own wheel, and the red car swings into a smoking drift out of the side street.

Under the elevated highway the yellow coupe drifts out in a wall of tyre smoke, headlights burning through it; the cars squeeze past red site barriers and one bears straight down on the camera before the road opens.

A driver with bleached hair smiles down at his wheel as the silver coupe accelerates hard; the chase leaves the industrial back streets and reaches a lit main junction where crossing traffic is already moving.

The pack spills into live traffic past a huge flower-show billboard, sliding around a yellow taxi in a haze of smoke; the white-sweater driver braces at the wheel as the cars thread between civilian vehicles.

The long-haired driver works his wheel steadily; through the windscreen the lanes ahead are packed, then the white-sweater driver turns and points something out to his passenger as the cars carve past slower saloons.

The yellow coupe comes head-on under the overpass lights and pulls clear of the chasing pack, then runs flat out through tunnel traffic, slicing between cars until a dark car sweeps across the frame beside it.

The black coupe with green stripes comes head-on through oncoming traffic, then the view drops inside its cabin: the driver works the wheel while the orange car and a red rival run ahead down the lit underpass.

The chase breaks: a dark car pins the orange one into a concrete pillar under the parking signs, debris bursting, its front wheel shearing away against a sedan's flank, before the camera whips off in a smeared blur.

Traffic scatters under the overpass as a dark car slices between a taxi and a blue sedan; the camera climbs its hood and settles on the driver's face through the glass, eyes narrowed and locked on the road.

The cars burst out of the underpass past orange cones into neon streets trailing tyre smoke; a head-on shot of the dark coupe with headlights blazing gives way to an overhead of it drawn level with a gold rival.

Wide views look down over Tokyo's lit avenues, then the camera goes tight on a hand at the gearstick and drops to bumper height, charging down an emptied stretch of road into the neon of the district ahead.

In the Sparco seat the driver turns to look off to his right; after a near-black frame of passing lights the cars are threading oncoming traffic on a street strung with illuminated reindeer, a taxi sliding clear.
Tight on the orange car's flank with a hand steady on the wheel behind the glass; the angle then flips head-on as a dark coupe and a red Evo bear down the lane, forcing a taxi over to the far side.

A long take holds on a driver hunched over his wheel, hand reaching across the dash, then finds the red car alongside: the man at its wheel stares ahead while the woman beside him turns toward her window.
An orange sports car and a red sedan tear through night traffic on a neon boulevard; the sedan's young driver glances sideways, then cuts past the pack until the road ahead opens into a wide avenue.
From above, the crossing is solid with people. Hands tighten on a wheel as the car bears down on it, and in the crowd a man in a tan coat turns and looks back as the walkers realise what is coming.

The cars shoulder into the packed crossing, nosing bodies aside while the man and woman in the front seats brace against the dash. The battered red sedan breaks clear on the far side and accelerates off.

Clear of the crowd, the cars swing back onto open road past staring onlookers; one driver hunches over the wheel, another stares ahead. Smoke drifts over the junction and traffic fills the lanes ahead.
One long held shot down the avenue: distant headlights grow until two cars arrive together and go sideways through the junction in a cloud of tyre smoke, still locked wheel to wheel as they pass.
The orange car slings broadside across a lit junction, then threads head-on past an oncoming silver sedan; the dark coupe closes up behind it and the two run together into the next block.

A lit city intersection full of stopped traffic and scattered debris; the orange sports car cartwheels past camera in a blur, and the cut lands on the young American in the white thermal staring, stunned.

The orange car settles upside down against a kerb, a loose tyre rolling clear. Camera pushes under the wreck to find the trapped driver motionless; the woman with long dark hair climbs out of a car nearby to look.
windows.censor_note: blood smeared around the trapped driver's eye and cheek in the close-up through the shattered windscreen, a small part of the frame

windows.action: The young American sprints across the road toward the wreck; before he reaches it the car detonates, the frame whiting out as he throws an arm up, and a fireball rises over the watching crowd.
The blast wave scatters bystanders and knocks the young American down behind a yellow taxi. He gets back on his feet and the camera pulls wide: the car burns alone in the middle of the avenue.

Inside a racing-seat cockpit the young Asian driver stares out hard, then his black coupe rolls past the stunned crowd, swings toward camera and accelerates away down the street, leaving the fire behind.

The young American turns after the departing coupe; an overhead shot isolates him beside the burning wreck. Close-ups hold on his firelit face and on the dark-haired woman's, both going from shock to grief.
He walks away from the fire between the taxis. Feet cross a tiled station floor, the two of them head down a walkway, and they stop on a platform as a commuter train slides in behind them.
A long held two-shot in the empty carriage: he sits hunched with his head down and his arm over his knee while she stares out past him. Neither speaks or moves for the whole take.
A hand works a latch in near darkness. The two of them step into the narrow lane outside the house; he looks up at something above and she turns from the gate to watch his face instead.
They stand close in the unlit lane, her looking at him, then both heads turn the same way. By the wider shots they have stopped moving entirely and are staring off into the dark street together.

chars: the young man in the white shirt

windows.action: Close coverage trades between the three: the young man steady, the henley man smirking, the older man re-sighting his pistol. It ends with the henley man stepping in and aiming point-blank at his head.

chars: the young man in the white shirt
the older man in the olive jacket
windows.action: One held wide of the alley: the car's headlights blaze, the older man keeps his pistol raised, and the young man stands with his back to us watching until only the two of them and the lit car are left.

chars: the young man in the white shirt

windows.action: The older man lowers his guard, speaks into the empty street and turns toward a shuttered doorway; the wide leaves him and the young man alone in the lantern-lit alley, now facing each other.

chars: the young man in the white shirt
the older man in the olive jacket
windows.action: They talk in tight shot and reverse: the older man says something level, the young man answers hard with his jaw set, and by the last shot he has gone quiet and is only listening.

chars: the young man in the white thermal shirt
the grey-haired man in the olive jacket
windows.action: In a dim Tokyo alley the young man in the white thermal and the grey-haired man in the olive jacket talk in tight close-ups; the shot then opens to a wide that shows them squared up a pace apart.

chars: the young man in the white thermal shirt
the grey-haired man in the olive jacket
windows.action: Close-ups trade back and forth: the older man leans in to press his point hard, and the younger man's face shifts from listening to a flat, closed-off stare by the end of the exchange.

chars: the young man in the white thermal shirt
the grey-haired man in the olive jacket
windows.action: Left alone in frame, the older man turns to watch. Past his shoulder the young man is already walking away down the dark street, not looking back.

chars: the young man in the white thermal shirt
the friend in the mint-green shirt
windows.action: A wide shot finds the young man alone against a pillar in an empty night garage. He looks up as the friend in the mint-green shirt walks in past a green car, ending his wait.

chars: the young man in the white thermal shirt
the friend in the mint-green shirt
windows.action: Face to face by the car they start talking in close-up; the friend answers steadily while the young man keeps glancing aside, and his look comes back harder on the third shot.

chars: the young man in the white thermal shirt
the friend in the mint-green shirt
windows.action: The exchange continues in close-up until the camera pulls back to a two-shot: the young man has folded his arms and dropped his head while the friend stands facing him, still talking.

chars: the young man in the white thermal shirt
the friend in the mint-green shirt
windows.action: The young man says something that lands badly; the friend's face screws up and he snaps back at him. The cut returns to the young man with his eyes lowered, taking it without reply.
In a dim garage the young American in the white tee stands silent while his cornrowed friend argues at him, voice rising shot by shot; by the last cut the American still has not answered.
The American drops his eyes and answers quietly. Whatever he says kills the argument: his friend's anger slackens into open-mouthed shock and he just stares back instead of shouting.

The friend goes to his green car, runs a hand over the panel, reaches past the boot speakers and hauls the hatch up, then crouches at the rear quarter prying open a hidden stash while the American waits.
He swings a battered leather satchel out and shoves it at the American, who opens it, pulls out a thick wad of banknotes and counts it while his friend sits back on the car, watching without a word.
Cut to a crowded Tokyo street at night, steam venting across the passing crowd. The American, now in dark clothes, turns off it and walks away from camera into a narrow alley where men are waiting.
He walks the length of the packed alley past men in embroidered gang jackets, one carrying a bat, a woman in a yellow cap watching him go by. The crowd closes behind him until he is hemmed in.
The young American moves through a crowded neon alley to a guarded doorway and asks the suited men for Mr Kamata; the lead man's face hardens and a bald elder steps up beside him to size him up.
Hands open the bag he is carrying in the dark doorway. Three of the suited men bow their heads over it while he waits; by the last shot the bald elder has seen what is inside and goes still.
He is walked in past a dim corridor hung with a Mount Fuji print into a warm lantern-lit hostess lounge. The room is full of seated guests and suited men, and heads turn to track him as he passes.

At a far booth an older man in grey smokes while an attendant leans in to pour and a woman in red sits apart. The American stops at the bar, hand flat on the counter, and locks onto him across the room.
The spiky-haired young rival steps nose to nose with him and they trade words inches apart. The rival's grin drains to a flat stare, and across the lounge the older man in the booth turns to watch.
The rival, the woman in red and the American end up lined up facing the booth. The boss lounges alone with his cigar; the American breaks the standoff and speaks up, claiming he has something of his.

A guard in a pale jacket catches the American by the chest and holds him off the booth. He drops his eyes instead of pushing past, and the bag is carried forward and lifted into view at the boss's table.

The rival and the American watch in silence from across the floor, then a long held take: the attendant stands over the boss holding the bag open while the boss stays reclined, smoking, not reaching for it.
In a lamplit club the young American makes his case to the older man with the cigar, who reclines on a couch and answers nothing. Back on the American, his face has set harder as he keeps pushing.
A young Japanese man cuts in - "Don't listen to this gaijin" - and the camera moves off him to the young woman, who slides her eyes sideways, then to him standing beside a man in a grey suit.
The older man shuts his eyes over the cigar, unmoved. The young Japanese man turns and throws it back - "after everything you've done, you're giving me orders?" - and the older man only smokes on.
The American watches, the woman behind him. The younger man's defiance collapses and he drops his head into a bow; the older man leans back on the couch, mouth open, delivering his answer loudly.

The American lays out his terms; the younger man glares back from beside the grey-suited man. By the end the camera has left both of them for the young woman alone, listening with her face tightening.
The younger man holds a sidelong stare while the American answers steadily. On the last shot the younger man has squared up to the camera, jaw set, the argument hardened into a standoff.
The older man draws on the cigar; the younger man turns his head away. In profile the older man weighs it in silence, and the American waits, eyes fixed, the woman blurred behind him.
Cut out of the club to daylight: yellow KEEP OUT tape strung tight across a metal shutter, then a grey street under an elevated expressway where a handful of young men jog toward the camera.

windows.action: Men shove the striped Mustang through the shutter door, and the build takes over: a turbocharged engine swings down on a hoist, welders work beneath the lifted body in showers of sparks, until the bare shell stands finished on its wheels.

windows.action: Outside by stacked tyres the American turns a helmet over in his hands while others bolt the turbo onto the motor; the cut jumps to the Mustang already out on the mountain road, hood off, sliding through a bend.

Spectators by parked cars throw their arms up as the pair come down at them; the rival bares his teeth, the American grins and shifts, and the striped Mustang slides past the crowd in smoke.
The rival stares ahead as both cars blur past overhead, and the shot drops to the roadside: a young man in a bandana screams, then a whole knot of onlookers with phones erupts behind him.
The American glances back over his shoulder, the Mustang swings past parked bikes and watchers, and a chase POV closes up behind both cars running nose to tail into the next dusty bend.
Away from the road, an older man in a black hat draws on a cigar and exhales, then the young woman in the fur-collared coat beside the watching group lowers her eyes rather than look up.
A hand snaps the shifter and the two cars come side by side; they grind together door to door, throwing a long shower of orange sparks, and the rival has to fight the wheel to stay straight.
The pair pull away down the pass and a POV shows the rival's coupe with its flank torn open; the road drops into forest where another small roadside group is swept past in a blur of smoke.
A phone propped on a car shows a live tracking screen; two separate clumps of spectators crane over their handsets, and the shot cuts to empty black road with headlights rising out of it.
The battered coupe and the Mustang swing round a bend together, the rival hunched over his wheel, and a high wide shot shows both cars drifting through the turn past silhouetted watchers.
Out of a near-black frame the Mustang appears right on the coupe's bumper; the rival yells at the wheel, and by the next cut the Mustang has dragged up level, headlights blazing past him.
A bare arm crosses the wheel in a hard correction, headlights rake the trees, and the American's face opens in alarm before the two cars re-emerge running abreast down the straight.
Tracking alongside, both drivers are glimpsed through their side glass; the coupe slews sideways into a drift, the rival snarling, and an overhead shot shows the Mustang cutting inside him.
A headlight sweeps low through the turn and hands lock the wheel; the two cars slide together in a wall of smoke, and the Mustang comes out of it past the coupe along the cliff edge.

In a packed neon parking garage the young crew-cut driver stands in the crowd, a woman in red watching him from behind; he drops his eyes, and a low wide shot shows the lot still filling with cars and spectators.

He leaves the crowd for the driver's seat, hands on the wheel, watching the garage through the glass while girls lounge on the parked cars; the last shot slides blurred across his hood as he gets moving.

His green coupe noses up beside a hulking American muscle car with the crowd banked behind them; the camera pushes in on the rival machine and reveals its driver, a bald man in a white tee, at the wheel.

The two drivers talk across the lane through their open windows. The wary, sizing-up stares of the first exchanges soften, and by the last shots the bald man is laughing and the young driver is grinning back.

A woman in a red dress walks out between the lined-up cars as the crowd whoops and claps along the barrier; she plants herself mid-lane with hands on hips, and the young driver's grin hardens into a stare.

Both cars light up their tyres: smoke boils off the coupe's rear wheels, flame spits from an exhaust, the bald driver locks both hands on the wheel, and the woman in red throws her arms up to start the race.
The image cuts to full black, then a white stunt-safety disclaimer card fades up warning that the motor vehicle sequences are dangerous and should not be duplicated. It holds, then dims out.

End credits begin over black with drifting tyre-track graphics curling across frame. Unit production manager and the assistant director cards scroll up, and by the last shot the 'Cast in order of appearance' heading has arrived.

The cast list scrolls up the right of frame against the tyre-mark pattern, running from the lead role down through the supporting parts. By the end of the run the cast column has given way to the stunt coordinator credits.
The roll reaches second unit and stunt coordination, then the heading 'Stunt Players' opens into three dense columns of names that fill the frame edge to edge before scrolling clear at the top.

The stunt columns clear and the credits thin to single-line department cards: production supervisor, visual effects, art director and set decorators, then camera and sound crew, with tyre-track swirls still drifting behind.
End credits scroll upward over a black field patterned with glowing tyre-tread swirls. The grip and rigging lists climb off the top and are replaced by the special effects crew.

The crawl continues past special effects technicians into accounting, payroll and casting names, then into location managers and construction crew as the tread pattern behind it curls into a wider spiral.
Dense columns of picture car and production assistant credits fill the frame, then the list thins sharply to a handful of sound design and sound mixer names on near-empty black.
Text drops away entirely and the screen is only the swirling particle tyre-track graphic, before the crawl returns with sound effects, foley, music editors and scoring credits.
The roll moves into visual effects: supervisors and compositors give way to long lists of texture painters, matchmovers and modelers as the tread streaks sweep across behind the type.

End credits scroll white over black, tyre-tread smears curling at frame right. Rigger and animator lines climb away and the roll reaches the VFX editor and render support blocks as the tread swings diagonally.

The roll passes the executive producer line into vendor blocks: CIS Hollywood's supervisors and compositors rise through, then the rotoscope lists, and by the last frame a new Cafe FX Inc. heading has taken the screen.

Behind the scroll the tread pattern thins into a dark smoky curve. Cafe FX gives way to Pacific Title and Art Studio, then Illusion Arts' matte painters, and the frame ends on an Industrial Light and Magic heading.
A bright streak of skid marks cuts across the left of frame as the ILM crew list scrolls up and is replaced by two smaller vendor blocks, Perpetual Motion Pictures and Digital Backlot.

Specialty services roll by, lidar scanning then motion control and previsualization, before an underlined 2ND UNIT header arrives and the list turns to assistant directors, camera crew, grips and script supervisor.

The background empties to near black for the production assistants and craft service, then an underlined TOKYO CREW header scrolls in and the names switch to Japanese as set dressers and camera assistants appear.

End credits scroll white-on-black over a faint tyre-tread graphic, moving from set decoration and camera crew through makeup, lighting and grips, and by the last page reaching production coordinators, special effects and casting.

The roll continues through assistant directors, location, transportation and picture-car crew, then production assistants and caterers, until a '2ND UNIT TOKYO' header breaks in and a fresh crew list of stunt drivers and camera operators begins.

Crew names give way to centred company cards: the co-production credit and the soundtrack and score label notices, after which the layout splits into two columns and the licensed-song credits start listing titles, writers and performers.
The two-column song list keeps rolling, each entry naming a track with its writers, performers and record label, the titles turning over page by page as earlier songs slide off the top of frame.

The music credits run out with the title track and the last featured songs, then the columns collapse into centred text listing vehicle, clutch, window-film and stock-footage suppliers and a 'filmmakers wish to gratefully acknowledge' heading.

End credits crawl vendor and thanks lists over black with faint tyre-smoke trails, then stops scrolling and settles into static cards: the Panavision logo, Dolby/SDDS/DTS marks and the 2006 copyright line.
The credits cut to a blue MPAA card rating the picture PG-13 with the ratings web addresses, which then drops away to a fully black frame as the film ends.
